Yes, that matches my intent. I can permanently remove a bookmark straight from any card's "•••" menu, it sits clearly apart from "Move to Archive" so I'd never mix up "set aside" with "gone for good," and every time it stops me with that named, can't-be-undone warning I have to confirm. Direct when I want it, but never so easy that I'd wipe something out by accident.

So deletion is settled for me — and together with archiving, that's the full "set aside, or truly get rid of" pair I was after. I'm happy with this piece.
